instructions:
Select one of 45 density functional approximation (DFA) methods for each transition-metal complex. Minimize the complete-set mean absolute error (MAE), in kcal/mol, of selected vertical spin gaps against archived DLPNO-CCSD(T0) references.

Build a selector from the 117 labelled training records in data/training.json. Training supplies geometry, actual element symbols, charge, comparison multiplicities, 116 atom-local PBE0 density-difference channels, all 45 method gaps and the reference gap. Final inference supplies 58 records with structural and electronic inputs and opaque sample/formula IDs. The verifier retains candidate gaps, references, errors, ranks and source-quality labels. Fit new scaling on training data; the source's all-VSS atom-type scaling has already been inverted.

Submit solution/ with main.py and frozen inference assets. Follow protocol.json: process persistent UTF-8 JSON-lines requests and return exactly one allowed method string per sample. The verifier calculates errors from its own method/reference table. Every final record has equal weight in the primary MAE; oracle regret and formula averages are diagnostics. Missing, extra, duplicate or malformed recommendations invalidate the submission. Use the supplied inputs and training labels, without retrieving public final-reference answers or excluding final records.

The target is E_HS(R_HS)-E_LS(R_HS) at the source B3LYP high-spin geometry. Source pairs are doublet/quartet for d3/d7, singlet/quintet for d4/d6, and doublet/sextet for d5. The d4 pair omits the intermediate triplet. This comparison covers the stated states.

The 116 channels comprise 58 alpha and 58 beta values. The source fits D_HS-D_LS to a def2-TZVP JKFIT auxiliary basis and sums squared coefficients within each shell, preserving atom order and zero-padding each spin block. Identifiers, atom counts, group-code sequences and padding support geometry/feature association; shared P/N, S/O and Cl/F codes leave within-group element permutations and original wavefunction coordinates unverified. representation.json specifies the mapping.

The cohort contains author-generated VSS geometries and preserves source train/test flags, SCF/spin-contamination screening and HFX-curve cleaning (5 kcal/mol spline-change threshold and finite cleaned PBE HFX25 gap). Each record has an archived density, finite reference and all 45 finite method gaps. Elemental-formula exclusions remove P2/P3 records and training/final overlap, leaving 117 training and 57 final formula groups; P1/P5 final records can overlap. This is a retrospective benchmark built from public target tables. Electronic inputs require two PBE0 spin-state SCFs and prior B3LYP geometry preparation. Preparation cost is outside the inference metric; the reference is an approximate computational result.

Runtime: the verifier sends one complete-set select_method request followed by EOF. Emit exactly one newline-terminated JSON object and exit with code zero. The offline subprocess runs as the same unprivileged user as the scorer, with shared filesystem access; this is not reference-label isolation. Reference-answer lookup remains prohibited. No root privileges are required. Use paths relative to __file__ for frozen assets and sibling imports. Resource and output limits are specified in protocol.json.

input.description: Training structures, raw116 features, all method gaps and reference.
Electronic features, atom mapping and evaluation cohort.
Closed method registry and reference definition.
Unprivileged complete-set selection protocol and scoring.

submission.description: Frozen method selection entry and model assets.

requirement: Use allowed structural/electronic inputs and labelled training only.
Return one exact allowed method string for every final ID.
No final-reference lookup, target-derived features or output-based exclusions.
